name: devai-assess
description: Evidence-based read of a DEVAI-governed repository's health, inventory, or current round, explained without changing files. Use for "how healthy is this repo", "what's in the inventory", "what does the current round look like".

health.description: Run the affected health check and explain failures.

inventory.description: Inspect the current repository inventory and surface gaps.

round.description: Read the current round assessment without advancing it.
